DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで絵を描いていましたが、日陰がなくなりました。ほかの日陰の席へ移ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日陰が移動した写生席から別の日陰へ移れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was drawing here, but this seat is no longer in the shade. May I move to another shaded seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may move from your sketching seat, now out of the shade, to another shaded spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いている一般の席なら確認できます。移る先に誰かの荷物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check an unoccupied public seat. Is there anyone's luggage where you want to move?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鞄が置いてある席があります。空席だと思いましたが、使っている人がいるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 候補席に鞄があり他人使用中の可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a seat with a bag on it. I thought it was free, but someone might be using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a bag is on the candidate seat, so another person may be using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その席の荷物を動かさず、別の場所を見ましょう。画材も全部運べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's find somewhere else without moving that seat's luggage. Can you carry all your art materials too?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 運べます。紙だけ先に置いて二つの席を取るのでなく、絵の具を閉じてから移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二席占有せず絵具を閉じ全画材を運ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than put down just my paper first and occupy two seats, I'll close the paints before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will close your paints and carry all your materials without occupying two seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに今空いている席があります。通路で筆を洗わず、使った物はまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's an empty seat here now. Please don't wash brushes in the passage, and gather your used items together.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水の容器にもふたをします。元の席の紙くずも拾って持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水容器を閉じ紙屑も回収して移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also close the water container. I'll pick up the paper scraps at the original seat and take them with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will close the water container and collect paper scraps before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。移った後も、ご自身の道具が通路へ出ないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. After moving, please also keep your equipment from extending into the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の席を片付け、空いた日陰へ全道具を運びます。ほかの人の荷物には触れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元席片付けと道具全移動を行い他人荷物を動かさないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tidy the original seat and carry all my equipment to the vacant shaded seat. I won't touch anyone else's luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will tidy the old seat, move all equipment, and not move others' belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。休憩も取りながら写生をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy sketching, and take breaks too.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 音声ガイドが速く感じます。速度をゆっくりにできるボタンはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 速く感じる音声ガイドの速度変更機能を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: The audio guide feels fast. Is there a button to make it play more slowly?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a speed-change function for the audio guide that feels too fast.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この端末に速度変更はありませんが、停止と再生を使えます。どの説明を聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: This device has no speed adjustment, but you can stop and play it. Which explanation are you listening to?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の長い説明です。先へ進みながら聞いたので、何の展示か途中でわからなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩きながら長い第一説明を聞き対象展示不明になったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first long explanation. I listened while walking ahead and lost track of which exhibit it referred to.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that listening to the long first explanation while walking made you lose track of the exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内番号の展示の前へ戻り、一つの説明だけ再生できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can return to the exhibit with that guide number and play just one explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を合わせて聞き直します。一度に最後まで覚えるより、途中で止めて展示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号一致の展示で一章を停止しながら聞き直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll match the number and listen again. Rather than remember everything in one go, I'd like to stop partway and look at the exhibit.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to replay one section at the matching numbered exhibit, stopping as you listen.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停止しても、その章を再び最初から聞けます。隣の展示の番号へ変えないよう確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even after stopping, you can listen to that section again from the beginning. Please make sure not to switch to the neighboring exhibit's number.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。短い所で止め、見えた物をメモしてから同じ章をもう一度聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短区切り停止と観察メモ後に同章を再生すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll stop after a short portion, note what I see, and listen to the same section again.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop in short segments, make observation notes, and replay the same section.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの方の通路を空けた位置でお使いください。音はイヤホンで聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use it from a position that leaves others' passage clear. You can listen through earphones.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 速度を探す操作はやめ、番号を合わせて一章ずつ止めながら見学します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 速度機能を探さず番号合わせ章ごと停止して見学すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stop looking for speed controls, match the numbers, and visit one section at a time while stopping playback.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop searching for a speed function, match the numbers, and pause each section while visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞご自分のペースでお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please enjoy it at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見学のアンケートをもらいました。この五段階の欄は、どれが正解ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見学アンケート五段階評価の正解を求めて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a visitor questionnaire. Which answer is correct in this five-point rating field?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the correct answer on the visitor survey's five-point scale.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらはご感想を伺う欄です。展示を理解できたかを採点する問題だと思われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field asks for your impressions. Did you think it was a question testing your understanding of the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。間違えると見学を終えられないと思いました。友人が選んだ数字を写そうとして、まだ書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 理解度採点と誤解し友人の数字を写すつもりだったが未記入と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought I couldn't finish the visit if I got it wrong. I was going to copy my friend's number, but haven't written anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook it for a comprehension test, intended to copy your friend's number, but have not filled it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身がどう感じたかを伺います。選択肢の言葉に分からない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: We want to know how you felt yourself. Are there words in the choices that you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 満足という言葉を短く説明してもらえますか。数字を選んでもらうのでなく、意味を知って自分で答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 満足の意味の平易説明を求め回答数字は本人で選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you briefly explain “satisfied”? I don't want you to choose a number for me; I'd like to understand the meaning and answer myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a plain explanation of “satisfied” and say you want to choose the answer number yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期待に合ってよかったと思う気持ちを表します。見ていない展示の質問もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: It expresses feeling pleased because something met your expectations. Are there also questions about exhibits you haven't seen?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二階はまだ見ていません。そこもよかったと書かず、未見学の場合の記入方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二階未見学で好評価を捏造せず未見学時記入方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't visited the second floor yet. Rather than write that it was good too, I'd like to ask how to fill it in when I haven't seen it.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not seen the second floor and ask how to answer for an unseen area rather than inventing a positive rating.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その欄の扱いを担当と確認します。お友達と違う感想でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person responsible how to handle that field. It's fine if your impressions differ from your friend's.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 選択肢を理解して、自分が見た部分の感想を書きます。二階は見ていないと伝え、記入方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見学済部分の本人感想と未見学部分を分け設問の扱いを確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll understand the choices and write my impressions of what I've seen. I'll explain that I haven't seen the second floor and check how to fill that in.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will distinguish your own impressions of visited areas from unseen areas and check how to handle the questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。設問を一緒に確認しましょう。ご感想をお聞かせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's check the questions together. Thank you for sharing your impressions.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で大きな音を録音しました。途中に私の説明も入っているので、分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 路上録音に自分の説明も混在するため区別して相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I recorded a loud sound on the street. My own explanation is included partway through, so I'd like to discuss those separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your own explanation is mixed into a street recording and you want to distinguish it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の録音をお持ちですね。ご自身の声はどの部分にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have the original recording, correct? Which part contains your voice?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は周囲の音で、その後私が「事故かもしれない」と話しています。事故を見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 環境音後の事故かもしれない発言は本人推測で事故未目撃と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: It starts with surrounding sounds, then I say, “It might be an accident.” I didn't actually see an accident.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your statement after the ambient sound was your own guess and you did not witness an accident.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 録音した音と、ご本人の推測の発言を別に伺います。編集しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask separately about the recorded sound and your speculative statement. Have you edited it?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。自分の声を消して環境音だけにする前に、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人声を削除編集せず原音を持参したと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. Before removing my voice to leave only the surrounding sound, I brought it as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you brought the original audio without editing out your voice.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の記録を残してください。録音した場所と、実際に見たことも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the original recording. We'll also ask where you recorded it and what you actually saw.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の前です。人が集まっていましたが、けが人や車の接触は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店前人集合は見たが負傷接触は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: In front of a shop. People were gathering, but I didn't see anyone injured or vehicles colliding.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you saw people gathering outside a shop but did not confirm injuries or a collision.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた事実として記録します。自分の説明が始まる所も担当へ示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record those as the facts you confirmed. Please also show the person responsible where your own explanation starts.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原音を残し、自分の声の部分と環境音の部分を示します。事故発生とは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元音保存と本人発言区間明示を行い事故を断定しないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll preserve the original audio and point out my voice section and the surrounding-sound section. I won't assert that an accident occurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will preserve the original, identify your spoken section, and not claim an accident happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談担当へ引き継ぎます。ご説明ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass this to the adviser. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段の薬を持ち歩くケースを探しています。この曜日の印がある物に薬も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯用曜日ケースに薬が付属するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for a case to carry my usual medicines. Does this one marked with weekdays include medicine too?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a portable weekday pill case comes with medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは空の収納ケースです。中の薬を販売するセットではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is an empty storage case. It is not sold as a set with medicine inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。自分の薬を入れたいですが、包装から出してよいかはまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空ケースへ本人薬を入れる希望だが包装取外し可否は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'd like to put my own medicines in it, but haven't checked whether I may take them out of their packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to put your own medicine in the empty case but have not confirmed whether packaging removal is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬ごとの保管条件は薬剤師へ確認してください。ケースだけで条件を満たすとは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check each medicine's storage conditions with a pharmacist. We can't assume the case alone meets those conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に薬の包装を見せて相談します。薬を混ぜて一つの区画へ入れることもまだしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬包装を薬剤師へ示し混薬や移替えを先にしないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll show the medicine packaging and ask first. I won't mix medicines into one compartment yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the packaging to a pharmacist and not mix or transfer medicines beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保管方法を確認してから、必要な大きさや区画を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking storage methods, you can choose the size and compartments you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開けやすさは見本で試したいです。販売用の封を切らずに確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 販売封を開けず見本で開閉しやすさを確かめたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to try the sample to see how easy it is to open. Can I check without breaking the seal on the item for sale?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check opening ease using a sample without opening a sales package's seal.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの見本で開閉できます。薬は入れずに使い心地だけ確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can open and close this sample. Please check only how it feels, without putting medicine in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見本で開閉を試し、薬の保管条件を確認できてから空ケースを買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本確認と薬保管条件確認後にケース購入を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll test opening the sample and decide whether to buy the empty case only after confirming the medicine's storage conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide on buying the case after testing the sample and checking medicine storage conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。薬の相談担当はこちらです。ご来店ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The staff for medicine consultations are here. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 試着室へ自分のカーディガンを置いてきました。試着した商品とは別の私物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試着商品と別の私物カーディガンを試着室へ残したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my own cardigan in the fitting room. It's a personal item, separate from the products I tried on.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you left a personal cardigan in the fitting room, separate from the tried-on merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの試着室を使い、いつ出られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which fitting room did you use, and when did you leave it?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二つ目です。十分ほど前に出て、店の商品は店員さんに返しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口二番目で十分前退出かつ試着商品は職員へ返却済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second from the entrance. I left about ten minutes ago and returned the store's products to a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the second fitting room from the entrance, leaving ten minutes ago, and already returning the merchandise to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私物の特徴を教えてください。店の商品と混ぜないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe your own item. We'll check so it doesn't get mixed with store merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薄い青色で、袖の内側に自分で直した縫い目があります。タグの色だけではわからないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄青色と本人修繕の袖縫い目を特徴として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's light blue, and there is a seam inside the sleeve that I repaired myself. I don't think the tag color alone will identify it.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the light-blue color and your own repaired sleeve seam.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴で担当が確認します。試着室にはほかのお客様がいらっしゃるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will check those features. There may be other customers in the fitting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分でカーテンを開けずに待ちます。商品の棚から似た物を持って帰ることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試着室を無断で開けず似た販売品も持ち帰らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait without opening the curtain myself. I won't take a similar item from the shop shelves home either.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not open the fitting room without permission or take home similar merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お客様の申告に合う物がありました。縫い目をご自身で確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've found something matching your description. Could you check the seam yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この直した縫い目は私の物です。私物だけを受け取り、試着した商品と分けて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修繕部で本人私物を照合して商品の返却と別に受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: This repaired seam shows it's mine. I'll take only my personal item and carry it home separately from the merchandise I tried on.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match your own item using the repaired part and say in Japanese that you will receive it separately from the returned merchandise.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できましたね。お忘れ物のないようお帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've confirmed it, then. Please make sure not to leave anything behind when you go. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋のカードが使えません。連れは先に帰りましたが、私は今夜も泊まる予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者退室後に本人カードが使えず今夜宿泊継続と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: My room card doesn't work. My companion has already left, but I plan to stay tonight too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about your card not working after your companion left, explaining that your own stay continues tonight.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご予約を確認します。同行者がフロントへカードを返したと聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your reservation. Have you heard that your companion returned a card to the front desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。連れは自分だけ帰るつもりでした。部屋全体のチェックアウトになったかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者は自分のみ退室意図で全体退室記録は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. They meant only to leave themselves. I don't know whether the entire room was recorded as checked out.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your companion intended only their own departure and you do not know whether the whole room was checked out.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の予約と退室の記録を照合します。別の部屋へ入ろうとはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare your own reservation with the checkout record. Please don't try to enter another room.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の名前と予約の残る日を伝えます。二人とも帰るという依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人予約日を示し二名全退室依頼ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll give my name and the dates remaining on my booking. It was not a request for both of us to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your own booking dates and say in Japanese that there was no request for both people to check out.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約情報を拝見しました。担当がカードと部屋の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've looked at the booking information. The person responsible will check the card and room status.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋に自分の鞄もあります。鍵を作り直す前に、今夜の宿泊が残るか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部屋内鞄を知らせ新カード前に本人宿泊存続確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: My bag is still in the room too. Before replacing the key, I'd like to confirm that tonight's stay remains booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell staff about the bag in your room and ask in Japanese to confirm your remaining stay before a new card is made.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順で確認します。同行者だけの退室と、ご本人の宿泊継続を分けて伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check in that order. We've noted your companion's departure separately from your continuing stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認が終わるまで待ちます。継続する本人分の案内とカードを受け取ってから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に本人継続案内とカードを受け部屋へ戻ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait until the checks are finished. I'll return after receiving the instructions and card for my continuing stay.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after confirmation you will receive the continuing-stay instructions and card, then return to the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの席でお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait at this seat. Thank you for discussing it with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 太鼓を撮りたくて三脚を広げました。足が通路へ出ているので、置ける場所を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 観覧用三脚の足が通路へ出るため設置位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened a tripod to photograph the drums. Its legs extend into the walkway, so I'd like to check where I can set it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to place a viewing tripod whose legs extend into the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この観覧区域では三脚を使わない案内です。まず畳んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tripods are not allowed in this viewing area. Please fold it up first.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示を見落としていました。撮影の前なので、三脚を畳んで手元へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用禁止表示を見落とし撮影前なので三脚を畳むと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I missed the sign. I haven't taken any photos yet, so I'll fold the tripod and keep it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you missed the no-use sign and will fold the tripod before any photography.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。観覧を続けるなら通行を妨げない位置をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. If you want to keep watching, I'll show you somewhere that doesn't obstruct passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 撮影場所を探して前へ割り込むのでなく、後ろから演奏だけ見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 割込撮影でなく後方で演奏のみ見る希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than push to the front looking for a photo spot, I'd like just to watch the performance from the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to watch from behind rather than cut in for photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの線の内側でご覧ください。畳んだ機材も足元へ突き出さないようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please watch from inside this line. Hold the folded equipment so it doesn't protrude around people's feet either.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋へ入れて体の横で持ちます。ほかの人の視線より上へ持ち上げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機材を袋に収納し体横保持で視界と通行を妨げないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put it in its bag and hold it beside my body. I won't lift it above other people's line of sight.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will bag the equipment and hold it beside you without obstructing views or passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。退席するときは演奏の動線へ入らず、一般通路を使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When leaving, use the public walkway rather than entering the performers' route.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三脚を使わず後方で観覧し、帰るときも一般通路へ出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三脚不使用観覧と一般通路で退席すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll watch from the back without using the tripod, and use the public walkway when I leave too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will watch without a tripod and leave by the public passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。どうぞ演奏をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for cooperating. Please enjoy the performance.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先生へお礼の菓子を贈ります。三人で買うので、のしに三人の名前を入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先生への御礼菓子に三人の贈り主名を入れたのしを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm giving my teacher sweets as thanks. Three of us are buying them, so can we put all three names on the noshi gift paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for noshi gift wrapping with three givers' names on sweets thanking a teacher.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前を確認してご相談できます。どのようなお礼でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can discuss it after checking the names. What are you thanking the teacher for?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 講座が終わったお礼です。先生が新しい仕事を始めるお祝いではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 講座終了のお礼で新仕事のお祝いではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: For the course that has ended. It isn't a celebration of the teacher starting a new job.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is thanks at the end of a course, not a new-job celebration.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ではお礼の趣旨を伺って準備します。表書きは「御礼」でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we'll prepare it for your purpose of thanks. Would “Thanks” be all right as the heading?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、「御礼」でお願いします。下の名前は先生の名前ではなく、私たち贈る三人ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表書き御礼を指定し下には先生ではなく贈り主名を書くか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, “Thanks,” please. The names below should be the three of us giving the gift, not the teacher's name, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the “Thanks” heading in Japanese and confirm the names below are the givers' rather than the teacher's.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 贈り主のお名前です。綴りを確認するため、三人のお名前をメモで見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: They are the givers' names. Could you show all three names in a note so we can check the spelling?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このメモです。名前を省略せずにお願いしたいですが、配置は見本を見て三人で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三人の綴りをメモで示し省略しない配置の見本を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the note. We'd like no names abbreviated; can all three of us check a sample of the layout?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the three spellings in a note and ask in Japanese to check a sample layout without abbreviating the names.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに配置の見本があります。仕上げる前に表書きとお名前を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is a layout sample. Please compare the heading and names before we finish it.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「御礼」と三人の名前で合っています。この配置で、先生へ渡すために包んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表書きと三人の名前配置を照合して贈答包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: “Thanks” and all three names are correct. Please wrap it in this layout for us to give to our teacher.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the heading and three-name layout, then ask in Japanese for gift wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認いただいた内容でお包みします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll wrap it with the details you confirmed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この絵は案内の写真より暗く見えます。写真と同じ色だと思ってメモしてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内写真と作品の色差を感じ写真色を同一として記録できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: This painting looks darker than the guide photograph. May I note down its colors as the same as the photograph's?
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can record the photo's colors as identical to the artwork, although you see a difference.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真を見る画面や展示の見え方で違いが出ます。今は電話の画面で見比べていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: The screen used to view a photograph and how an exhibit appears can cause differences. Are you comparing them on your phone now?

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。電話の明るさを上げた写真だけを見て、絵も鮮やかな青だと書きそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 高輝度の電話写真を根拠に鮮青と書きかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Looking only at the photo with the phone brightness turned up, I nearly wrote that the painting was vivid blue too.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you nearly wrote “vivid blue” based on a bright phone photograph.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 画面の色を作品の色と決めず、実際に見えた印象として記録できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than decide the screen color is the artwork's color, you can record it as your impression of what you actually see.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話をしまって、離れた所から絵を見ます。今の私には深い青に見えると書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話をしまい肉眼の深青という本人印象を記したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put my phone away and look at the painting from a distance. I'd like to write that it looks deep blue to me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the phone away and record your own impression of deep blue seen directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の鑑賞を妨げない位置でお願いします。解説にある色の言葉も別に控えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please stand where you won't disturb others viewing it. You can also separately note the color terms in the commentary.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 解説の記述と、自分が見えた印象を同じ事実として混ぜずに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 解説記述と主観観察を別々に記録すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write the commentary's description and my own visual impression separately, without mixing them as the same fact.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the commentary and your subjective observation separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。撮影の有無とは別に、言葉で観察を残せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Regardless of whether you take photographs, you can record observations in words.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 画面の色で断定せず、肉眼の印象と解説の表現を分けてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面色を断定根拠にせず肉眼と説明の表現を分けると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't draw a firm conclusion from the screen color; I'll note my direct impression separately from the commentary's wording.
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat in Japanese that you will not base a firm conclusion on screen color and will separate direct observation from the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞゆっくり作品をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-005-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your time looking at the work.
